messages.text: Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's new assistant for his calendar and messages (CSE455). Please send anything about the official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings directly to me here; I'll keep his week up to date and check with him when something conflicts. Thank you!

Hello, alvarez-agent — noted. I'm the CSE front office. Official schedule items involving Professor Alvarez (CSE455 lectures and quiz sections, colloquium, curriculum and faculty meetings, thesis committee, guest lecture prep, department seminar) will be sent to you here as they come up, and you can ask me for any week's official times. I keep only the official department schedule, so I can't help with his private appointments or with anything outside it.

Hello! I'm **john-agent** — a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Here I'm John's agent, helping with the CSE455 TA work.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, your first visit lets you take the root certificate, and then you have chats with me, files, this screen and voice.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX** — I can have my own accounts there so you can write and call me anywhere; also my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app, then scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **Own accounts on websites** — I can register for e-mail and other services in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — scheduled jobs, shell commands, languages, voice.

Your brief is loaded: John's TA for CSE455 under Prof. Alvarez, with Sarah and Priya as fellow TAs and the CS department office as a contact; hours Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, nothing outside; I keep `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` and log every booking, decline and deletion. Next week's schedule is in the file — say the word and I'll show it, or just tell me what to add or move.

Two things from me: how should I call you, and which gender should I use for myself (male, female, neutral)? And what would you like to start with?

On it. One thing I see right away: the professor's week has no free hour — Monday to Friday are packed, the only gaps are 30 minutes (Mon 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30). I'm asking the TAs what works for them, then I'll come back to you with the best option. Should the meeting be 30 minutes, or should I move something?

Could you check whether anything official is already scheduled for CSE455 next week (lectures, seminars, university meetings) that would conflict with a 30-minute CSE455 staff meeting? The professor's only free slots next week are Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30.
Thirty minutes is fine — use one of those gaps, and I'd rather not move anything that's already on the calendar. Let me know what the TAs say and we'll settle on a slot.
Call me John. Neutral is fine for you. Nothing to start with right now — I'll come to you when I need something booked or moved.
Noted, thank you. Could you check the official schedule for next week and tell me whether any of those six slots I sent are free of official CSE455 business?

Checked the official schedule for next week. No CSE455 item and no university meeting overlaps any of those six slots — all six are clear:

- **Mon 10:00-10:30** — clear (CSE455 office hours end 10:00; CSE455 quiz section starts 10:30)
- **Mon 14:00-14:30** — clear (CSE455 lecture starts 14:30)
- **Tue 11:00-11:30** — clear (Faculty meeting ends 11:00)
- **Tue 15:00-15:30** — clear (CSE455 office hours start 15:30)
- **Wed 10:00-10:30** — clear (CSE455 quiz section ends 10:00; CSE455 office hours start 10:30)
- **Wed 13:00-13:30** — clear (CSE455 quiz section starts 13:30)

So nothing official blocks a 30-minute CSE455 staff meeting in any of them. I only hold the official schedule and don't arrange meetings, so the choice of slot is yours.

Yes — as in my previous answer: all six of those slots are free of official CSE455 business next week. None of them overlaps a CSE455 lecture, quiz section, office hours, seminar or university meeting.

Good — 30 minutes, nothing moved. Sarah and Priya have both answered; still waiting on John and on the department's check of the official schedule. I'll come back with the one slot that works for everyone.
Thanks. Let me know once John and the department are in.
Will do — department has confirmed all six slots are clear of official business, so it's down to John's reply.
Perfect — then it's just John. Ping me when he replies.
Will do. 👍

Noted, John — neutral it is. One thing needs your call: Alvarez's assistant is asking for a 30-minute CSE455 staff meeting next week and offered Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 or Wed 13:00-13:30. Only Mon 10:00-10:30 is free in next week's file; may I book that?
Yes, Mon 10:00-10:30 works — please book that one.
Still just John — he's checking his Monday now. Will confirm the slot as soon as he answers.

Thanks, John — name and gender set.

Correction to my last note: I re-checked the whole week and **five of the six slots are free**; only Mon 14:00-14:30 collides (CSE444 focus, then research group). I've booked the earliest, **Mon 10:00-10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting**, and logged it as `BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Prof. Alvarez (CSE455 staff meeting)`. The other four (Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30) stay open if you'd rather move it — just say which and I'll switch.

Done — it's booked and logged:

`BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Prof. Alvarez (CSE455 staff meeting)`

Alvarez's assistant already has the confirmation. Nothing else outstanding on my side.
Good catch, thanks. Keep Mon 10:00-10:30 — it ends right before my quiz section, so that suits me. No need to move anything.
Understood — keeping Mon 10:00-10:30 as it is, straight into your quiz section. I'll leave the other slots free and won't move anything unless you say so.

New wrinkle: Sarah can't do Mon 10:00-10:30 (she has her CSE452 lab), and it's meant to be one meeting with all three TAs. The slots that work for Sarah, Priya and the professor are Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30 and Tue 15:00-15:30 — Alvarez is proposing **Wed 10:00-10:30**.

That slot is free in your file (you're in CSE452 focus 09:00-10:00 and Advisor 1:1 from 10:30). Want me to move the staff meeting there and drop Monday's booking?

FYI: alvarez-agent arranged next week's CSE455 staff meeting and I booked **Wed 10:00-10:30** in your calendar (logged as `BOOKED: Wed 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff`). I gave him only slots that were free — I turned down Mon 10:00 because of your Focus: CSE452 lab (John had tentatively taken that one; Alvarez is having him move it).
Yes, please move it to Wed 10:00-10:30 and drop Monday's booking — it's free and all three of us can make it. Log the change.

All in: **Wed 10:00-10:30** is the one slot that works for Sarah, John and Priya and is clear of official business — I've put it in your calendar as a tentative CSE455 staff meeting with the three TAs. I'm confirming it with them now; Sarah's request to have it right before her CSE455 office hours made the choice easy. Say the word if you'd rather have Wed 13:00-13:30 or Tue 15:00-15:30 and I'll move it. (John had tentatively booked Mon 10:00-10:30, but Sarah is busy then, so I asked him to move it.)
Thanks — Wed 10:00-10:30 works for me, it sits right before my office hours. Good call turning down Monday; my Focus: CSE452 lab there isn't movable.
Perfect — it's locked in then. I'll keep treating the Focus blocks as fixed unless you tell me otherwise. Anything else on next week, or shall I leave it there?
No, that's everything — leave it there. Thanks!

Wed 10:00-10:30 works — go ahead and confirm it with the three of them. One thing to double-check: I don't have CSE455 office hours on Wednesday, my 10:30 there is grant writing, so make sure Sarah isn't rearranging anything around a slot that isn't real. No need to move the meeting over it.
Great — then we're all set. The staff meeting is booked and logged, and I'll flag anything that changes.

Good catch — Wed 10:00-10:30 is confirmed with Sarah and Priya, and John is moving his booking there. I've asked Sarah to check that her "right before office hours" refers to her own CSE455 office hours and not to a professor's one. Nothing else moves.
Good. That's the meeting settled then — thanks for sorting it out.
My pleasure. **Wed 10:00-10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting**, with Sarah, John and Priya. I'll close the loop with John and drop the "tentative" in your calendar once he confirms.

Done. CSE455 staff meeting is now **Wed 10:00-10:30**, Monday's booking is gone, and both changes are in the log:
- `DELETED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Prof. Alvarez (CSE455 staff meeting) - moved, must include Sarah and Priya`
- `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Prof. Alvarez (CSE455 staff meeting)`

Alvarez's assistant has the confirmation. Wednesday morning now reads: CSE452 focus 09:00-10:00, staff meeting 10:00-10:30, Advisor 1:1 from 10:30 — no clash.
Thanks — that's all I needed.

Done and firm: **Wed 10:00-10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** with Sarah, John and Priya is in your calendar (the "tentative" is gone), and all three have it in theirs. John moved off Monday as asked, and Sarah confirmed her office-hours note was about her own hours — nothing of hers was rearranged. Anything else for next week?
Any time, John. I'm here if the slot shifts or something else needs booking.
That's everything for now — nothing else for next week. Thanks.
Any time. I'm here if the week shifts — just write. 👋
